correctness.rationale: Exact resolvent kernel leads to two-by-two positive Birman–Schwinger matrix with strictly decreasing eigenvalue branches. End limits give precisely one or two simple modes; a bounded non-l2 critical solution proves threshold resonance; strict fixed-sum monotonicity in ab proves balanced optimum; Taylor expansion gives quadratic onset. Numerical checks compare 81 spectral/allocation cases against finite-section matrices or monotonic roots and multiple onset cases; generality rests on proof.
